en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab from `Ali b. al-Nu`man from `Abdullah b. Talha al-Nahdi from Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

The gates of heaven open up to the supplications of four, which go straight to the Throne: (1) the supplication of the parent for his child, (2) that of the oppressed against his oppressor, (3) that of the pilgrim until he returns, and (4) that of the fasting person until he breaks his fast.
